architecture_scope_line: Desktop downloads are available for Linux x64 and Windows x64 only. No download is posted for Windows ARM64, Linux ARM64, and macOS x64 yet.
desktop_pick_line: If you see both desktop apps, start with Avalonia. Treat Blazor Desktop as a fallback path only when the download page or support explicitly tells you to use it.
fix_availability_summary: Only expect fix notices after the affected download is available on the download page.
known_issue_summary: No blocking download issue is listed for the current installers.
missing_installer_lane_line: Normal installers are available on every promised desktop platform.
quality_gap_line: Character math is already solid. The rough edges are mostly installer polish, update polish, and support polish.
release_verification_summary: This build handles installs and recovery, campaign session recovery, and support follow-up.
shelf_truth_line: The download page includes Windows and Linux downloads.
short_release_summary: Use the downloads listed here. If your platform is missing or preview-only, wait before switching full time.
